yoke.column.name: Yoke (roll / pitch)
yoke.column.note: yoke handle hub (shaft mount behind the centre cover); axes from the base

unplaced.yoke.button.1: generic placeholder without an input; no numbering sheet, not identifiable among the handle's controls

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-12), yoke handle seen from the pilot's side (front, slightly from the left), left horn with a red button and two hats, right horn with an encoder/hat cluster, three lit push buttons on each side of the centre cover; base not in the photo
mappingSource: catalog (product page https://virpil-controls.eu/constellation-vega-yoke-handle.html); no numbering sheet found, the catalog has no inputs for this handle
note: the catalog lists only a generic 'yoke button 1' with no input; the handle has many controls and none can be identified as 'button 1' -> not placed. yoke.column marked on the central hub where the handle meets the yoke shaft (shaft/base not in the photo); roll/pitch come from the Vector base.
